metadata.title: Ricci flow with metric torsion on surfaces of positive Euler characteristic
metadata.abstract: We study an adapted Ricci flow of connections with metric torsion on surfaces with positive Euler characteristic. We first prove that there do not exist any nontrivial solitons of the flow on the $2$-sphere thus confirming a conjecture of Branding--Kröncke (J. Geom. Anal. 27.3 (2017), arXiv:1606.09121 ). We give an explicit family of torsion data for which the corresponding global solutions fail to converge on $\mathbb{S}^2$. Nevertheless, we provide several sufficient conditions for the convergence of the flow to a stationary point. We first prove that the normalized adapted Ricci flow always converges on $\mathbb{RP}^2$, which completely answers a question in the paper of Branding and Kröncke. Using this, we deduce that the flow converges on $\mathbb{S}^2$ whenever the initial metric and the torsion one-form are antipodally symmetric. We also prove a Łojasiewicz--Simon gradient inequality for the flow and use it to prove convergence to a stationary point provided the solution is close to an arbitrary stationary point.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 研究正 Euler 特征曲面上的带挠率度量 Ricci 流，区分球面与射影平面的孤立子和长时间行为。
techniques: 挠率耦合的 Ricci 流
analysis.breakthrough: 证明 RP2 的归一化流收敛，同时给出 S2 上全局存在但不收敛的挠率例子及平稳点附近收敛。
analysis.limitations: S2 并非一般都收敛；RP2 与对跖对称球面结论、局部稳定结论需要分开。仅依据官方英文摘要及作者评论，尚未核查正文与完整证明；技术说明仅限摘要明确的信息，关键结论需回查原文。未见 AI 协作声明仅指这些已检查来源，不代表已核验整篇论文完全由人类完成。
analysis.priorityReason: 流的收敛与反例边界明确，解析方法对其他耦合流有借鉴价值。
